title: I built a 4-player arena bomb game with AI an AI coding assistant: local, CPU, online with room codes, and phones as controllers (free on itch.io)
author: Lotoreo1
selftext:
Hi everyone! I've been working on **Bombadroids**, a fast arena game for up to 4 players: drop bombs, blow up walls, grab power-ups, and be the last robot standing. I am not saying out loud which game from my childhood inspired it, but if you are as old as me, you will know :) 

**How AI was used:**

* Almost all the code was written with Claude Code, with me designing the game, playtesting, and deciding what goes in.
* There are no image or audio files. All graphics are drawn in code on an HTML canvas, and the sound effects are made by code too.
* The AI also set up the backend (Firebase for accounts and ranked play) and fixed the networking: client-side prediction against lag and a relay server for players behind strict networks.

**What's in it:**

* Up to 4 players in any mix of local, CPU and online
* Online play with friends using a 5-letter room code, no install needed
* Phones can join as controllers by scanning a QR code
* 16 arenas, including conveyor belts, warp zones, ice and gates
* 20 items, including Kick, Punch, Remote bombs, Bomb Pass, Throw, Shield, Dash, Frost and a cursed Skull
* An option where dead players drop their items across the arena
* Accounts with a ranked mode

**What I learned:**

* AI vibe coding went a long way in the last few months!
* There is a lot of semi-free functions available these days, for the backends and hosting.

It runs in the browser and is free: [**https://lotoreo.itch.io/bombadroids**](https://lotoreo.itch.io/bombadroids)

I'd love feedback, especially on balance, the CPU opponents and online lag. Happy to answer questions about the workflow!
